_comment: MIRROR of src/data/enemies.js maxHp, indexed by ENEMIES position. CARDINAL RULE: this file and src/data/enemies.js MUST be updated in the SAME commit — the sim reads this file, the live game reads enemies.js via getScaledMaxHp, and any drift means the sim measures a game that does not exist. Enforced automatically: vestibule-sim-kwstacks.js throws on load if any entry disagrees, and e2e/test-card-parity.cjs asserts the same before it connects. Aug 4 2026: entry 26 (Lucifer) said 666666 while enemies.js says 100000 — the sim had been fighting a 1,233,332 HP Lucifer (666666 x 1.85 deck scale) against live's 185,000, which voided every Lucifer winrate ever reported. Synced to enemies.js.
